description: Find the resource id of ONE person or ONE location by name. `type` is required ("person" or "location"); returns the 10 best matches; name search only (no code or id lookup), and an empty query returns nothing. These ids are what assign_item, adjust_stock, transfer_stock, set_min_stock, create_order (deliverToResourceId), create_item (homeLocationId) and create_location / create_person (parent) take. A "person" here is a PERSON RECORD (someone items can be assigned to), NOT a login account; member userIds come from list_members. Every row carries `path`, the ancestor names root to parent ("Schulhaus B" → "1. Obergeschoss" for a room, a department chain for a person), and `parentId`; when several locations share a name, the path tells them apart. An empty result [] means no match. list_resources returns both whole trees without a name.
name: search_resources

result.description: Up to 10 best name matches; empty array means no match

parentId.description: The parent resource's id (absent at the top level) — what create_location / create_person take as `parentId`

path.description: Ancestor NAMES, root→parent (e.g. ["Schulhaus B", "1. Obergeschoss"]); empty at the top level. When several rows share a name, this is what tells them apart

title: Search people & locations
